title: Twist Library Prep: Fragmentation & Repair
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol begins with samples diluted to 5ng/µL (if you still need to normalize your sample concentration, try our [Normalization protocol](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/normalization)) in either PCR tubes or a 96-well plate. Enzymatic Fragmentation Mastermix (40µL) is added to empty PCR tubes/96-well plate first, before 10µL of normalized sample is added. The PCR tubes/96-well plate containing sample and mastermix should then be moved off deck to thermocycler and run on the program listed in the [Twist Library Prep protocol](https://www.twistbioscience.com/sites/default/files/resources/2019-09/Protocol_NGS_EnzymaticFragUniversalAdapterSystem_11Sep19_Rev1.pdf). After the thermocycler, the samples can be returned to the OT-2 for [part two](https://develop.protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/21e4d8-pt
Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare sample concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute DNA samples to 5 ng/µL in either PCR tubes or a 96‑well plate before starting the workflow.

steps.title: Download protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol bundle files from the Opentrons repository.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If required, upload any custom labware definition files to the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Load the downloaded protocol files into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing tip racks, plates, and tubes in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the pipette, tip racks, and any labware on the deck.

steps.title: Add fragmentation mastermix and sample
steps.instruction: Dispense 40 µL Enzymatic Fragmentation Mastermix into each empty PCR tube or well, then add 10 µL of the 5 ng/µL normalized sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL Fragmentation Mastermix to each well.
Add 10 µL normalized DNA sample to the same well.

steps.title: Run thermocycler program
steps.instruction: Move the PCR tubes or 96‑well plate off the OT‑2 deck, place it in a thermocycler, and run the program specified in the Twist Library Prep protocol.

steps.title: Return plate for part two
steps.instruction: After the thermocycler run, place the plate or tubes back on the OT‑2 deck to continue with part 2 (Ligate Adapters).

steps.title: Start the OT‑2 run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the protocol.
